one_line: Kanpur rebels of 1857, grappling with pensions, treasuries, and their brief experiment in sovereign coinage on the Ganges.

appearance.age_look: Nana Sahib appears mid-30s, dignified and solidly built; Azimullah appears early-30s, lean and sharp-featured, both with upright, confident posture.
appearance.face: Nana Sahib has an oval face, wheatish complexion, neatly trimmed moustache, soft but determined eyes and a calm, calculating expression; Azimullah has a slightly longer face, fairer wheatish tone, pointed moustache and short beard, keen eyes, and a thoughtful, strategic gaze.
appearance.hair: Nana Sahib’s hair is black, parted in the middle and neatly combed back under a deep maroon Peshwa-style turban with a gold border; Azimullah’s hair is black, shorter and brushed back, mostly covered by a dark green turban with a slim golden edge.
appearance.costume: Nana Sahib wears a cream-coloured long cotton angarkha with subtle vertical weave, tied to the side with maroon fabric loops, over a maroon silk waist-sash; below are loose white churidar-style trousers and simple brown leather shoes; he has a short sleeveless maroon velvet waistcoat with thin golden piping around the armholes and front, and a narrow gold-bordered shawl in pale yellow draped over one shoulder; Azimullah wears a knee-length dark green angarkha with a slightly flared skirt and fine gold trim along the neck and front opening, over beige trousers and brown shoes, with a slim dark red sash at the waist and a simple cream shawl folded over his left arm; both have modest gold stud earrings and a discreet signet-style ring on the right hand.
appearance.signature: A small copper paisa coin held between Nana Sahib’s fingers, marked by a clear raised rim and central motif, accompanied at his belt by a sheathed straight talwar with a traditional steel hilt and no ornate fantasy elements.

ref_desc: Nana Sahib has an oval wheatish face, maroon turban, cream angarkha, maroon sash and paisa coin with talwar at his belt, beside lean Azimullah in dark green angarkha, green turban, beige trousers, brown shoes and cream shawl, all in cream-maroon-green-gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Nana Sahib and Azimullah Khan standing side by side on the Ganges plain in 1857: Nana Sahib is mid-30s with an oval wheatish face, neat moustache, calm determined eyes, black hair under a deep maroon Peshwa-style turban with a gold border; he wears a cream-coloured long cotton angarkha with subtle vertical texture, tied at the side with maroon loops, a maroon silk waist-sash, white churidar-style trousers and simple brown leather shoes, plus a short sleeveless maroon velvet waistcoat edged with thin golden piping and a narrow pale yellow gold-bordered shawl over one shoulder. He holds a small copper paisa coin between his fingers, and a sheathed straight talwar with a traditional steel hilt hangs at his belt. Beside him, Azimullah Khan is early-30s, lean, with a slightly longer wheatish face, pointed moustache and short beard, keen eyes, and black hair under a dark green turban with a slim golden edge; he wears a knee-length dark green angarkha with a slightly flared skirt and fine gold trim along neck and opening, beige trousers, brown shoes, a slim dark red waist-sash, and a simple cream shawl folded over his left arm. Use a clean shonen-anime look but keep all garments, colours and accessories historically grounded, with a harmonious palette of cream, maroon, dark green, gold and brown.
